response.text: All tests passing. The rectangle union library correctly handles: (1) overlapping rectangles using coordinate compression algorithm which avoids undercounting, (2) reversed/negative coordinates by normalizing with min/max before storing, and (3) fractional coordinates with arbitrary precision using Python's Fraction class for exact rational arithmetic instead of floating-point. The CLI properly reads stdin with support for integer and rational (n/d) input, and outputs reduced integer or n/d format.
